# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-api-docs.mjs from the code. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:api`. -->

Base URL: `/api/v1` (the health check is `/health`). 251 endpoints.
Interactive documentation: `/api/docs` (Swagger UI, not in production unless `SWAGGER_ENABLED=true`).
Machine-readable: [`docs/api/openapi.json`](api/openapi.json); Postman: [`docs/api/ROF-LMS.postman_collection.json`](api/ROF-LMS.postman_collection.json).

**Conventions.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`).
Lists return `{ data, meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }` with `?page=&limit=` (max 100).
Errors return `{ statusCode, error, code, message, details?, requestId }`; branch on `code`.
Unknown body or query fields are rejected (`VALIDATION_FAILED`).

## Academic years

### GET `/api/v1/academic-years`

**Access:** STUDENT, MENTOR, ADMIN

All academic years (newest first), e.g. for filters.

Returns `200` JSON, an array of objects with:

`_count` object · `closedAt` any or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `endsOn` string (date-time) · `id` string (uuid) · `isCurrent` boolean · `name` string · `startsOn` string (date-time) · `status` string · `updatedAt` string (date-time)

### GET `/api/v1/academic-years/current`

**Access:** STUDENT, MENTOR, ADMIN

Returns `200` JSON with:

`closedAt` any or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `endsOn` string (date-time) · `id` string (uuid) · `isCurrent` boolean · `name` string · `startsOn` string (date-time) · `status` string · `updatedAt` string (date-time)

### POST `/api/v1/admin/academic-years/{id}/activate`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Start the year: closes the current one (archiving its assignments) and
rolls every active student over — promoted one grade when requested.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `promoteStudents` | boolean | ✓ | Move every active student up one grade (true at the start of a new school year). |
| `deactivateGraduates` | boolean |  | When promoting, deactivate S6 students who graduate (default true). |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`academicYear` object · `assignmentsArchived` integer · `carriedOver` integer · `graduated` integer · `newlyEnrolled` integer · `promoted` integer

Returns `200` JSON with:

|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

|---|---|:-:|---|

Returns `200` JSON with:

`academicYearId` string (uuid) · `divisionId` string (uuid) · `endedAt` any or null · `enrolledAt` string (date-time) · `gradeLevel` string · `id` string (uuid) · `schoolId` string (uuid) · `status` string · `studentId` string (uuid)

## Admin · Email

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/jobs`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Jobs with progress counters (no message bodies).

Returns `200` JSON with:

`data` object[] · `meta` object

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/jobs/{id}`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`completedAt` string (date-time) · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `createdBy` object · `failedCount` integer · `id` string (uuid) · `idempotencyKey` string · `sentCount` integer · `status` string · `subject` string · `totalRecipients` integer

### GET `/api/v1/admin/email/jobs/{id}/deliveries`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Per-recipient delivery status (filter with ?status=FAILED).

|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`data` object[] · `meta` object

### POST `/api/v1/admin/email/jobs/{id}/retry`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Re-queue FAILED deliveries. SENT deliveries are never re-sent.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `201` JSON with:

`jobId` string (uuid) · `message` string · `requeued` integer

### POST `/api/v1/admin/email/send`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Queue a bulk e-mail. Returns the job immediately; sending happens in the
background. Re-using an idempotencyKey returns the original job
(`alreadyExisted: true`) instead of sending again.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `idempotencyKey` | string | ✓ | Idempotency key supplied by the caller. Re-submitting the same key returns the existing job rather than dispatching duplicate messages. Use a UUID or a stable hash. |
| `recipientMode` | EXPLICIT \| ROLE \| DIVISION \| SCHOOL \| ALL | ✓ |  |
| `recipientUserIds` | string[] |  | Required when recipientMode is EXPLICIT. Maximum 500 recipients per request. |
| `recipientRole` | string |  | Required when recipientMode is ROLE. Valid values: STUDENT | MENTOR | ADMIN |
| `recipientDivisionId` | string (uuid) |  | Required when recipientMode is DIVISION. |
| `recipientSchoolId` | string (uuid) |  | Required when recipientMode is SCHOOL. |
| `subject` | string | ✓ |  |
| `body` | string | ✓ | Plain-text message body. HTML is intentionally not supported to reduce XSS risk and simplify the implementation. Add HTML support here when needed. |

Returns `201` JSON with:

`alreadyExisted` boolean · `completedAt` any or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `createdBy` object · `dryRun` boolean · `failedCount` integer · `id` string (uuid) · `sentCount` integer · `status` string · `subject` string · `totalRecipients` integer

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

| `page` | query | number |  | Page number (1-based). |
| `limit` | query | number |  | Page size (default: 50, max enforced in service). |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`data` object[] · `meta` object

## Admin · Permissions

### GET `/api/v1/admin/permissions/catalogue`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

### GET `/api/v1/admin/users/{id}/permission-overrides`

**Access:** SUPER_ADMIN

The user's overrides, newest first (active and past).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` JSON, an array of objects with:

`active` boolean · `courseId` any or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `createdBy` object · `divisionId` any or null · `effect` string · `expiresAt` any or null · `id` string (uuid) · `permission` string · `reason` string · `revokeReason` any or null · `revokedAt` string (date-time) · `revokedBy` object

### POST `/api/v1/admin/users/{id}/permission-overrides`

**Access:** SUPER_ADMIN

Add an override, validated against the approved list (400 OVERRIDE_NOT_ALLOWED otherwise).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `permission` | string | ✓ | A permission name from the catalogue (GET /admin/permissions/catalogue). |
| `effect` | GRANT \| DENY | ✓ | GRANT adds a permission (approved list only); DENY removes a default one. |
| `reason` | string | ✓ | Why the override is needed (kept in the audit trail). |
| `expiresAt` | string |  | When it stops applying (ISO 8601, in the future). Omit for no expiry. |
| `courseId` | string (uuid) |  | GRANT only: the course × division it applies to (must be within the user's existing scope). |
| `divisionId` | string (uuid) |  |  |

Returns `201` JSON with:

`active` boolean · `courseId` any or null · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `createdBy` object · `divisionId` any or null · `effect` string · `expiresAt` string (date-time) or null · `id` string (uuid) · `permission` string · `reason` string · `revokeReason` any or null · `revokedAt` any or null · `revokedBy` any or null

### DELETE `/api/v1/admin/users/{id}/permission-overrides/{overrideId}`

**Access:** SUPER_ADMIN

|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |
| `overrideId` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` JSON with:

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |

| `schoolId` | string (uuid) | ✓ |  |
| `note` | string |  |  |
| `confirmDifferentPlace` | boolean |  | Required when the school's province, district or sector differs from what the student entered. |

Returns `200` with no body.

## Admin · Schools

### GET `/api/v1/admin/schools`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Every school — official, Administrator-created and legacy; active and inactive — with student counts.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `q` | query | string |  | Name (contains) or code (starts with). |
| `countryCode` | query | string |  |  |
| `province` | query | string |  |  |
| `district` | query | string |  |  |
| `sector` | query | string |  |  |
| `isActive` | query | boolean |  |  |
| `source` | query | ADMIN \| OFFICIAL_LIST \| LEGACY |  |  |
| `level` | query | string |  | Offers this education level (e.g. PR, OL, AL). |
| `programme` | query | string |  | Offers this programme (its id). |
| `accommodation` | query | DAY \| BOARDING \| MIXED |  |  |
| `hasCode` | query | boolean |  | false: schools without an official code. |
| `hasSourceIssues` | query | boolean |  | true: schools whose source records report data problems. |

Returns `200` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/admin/schools`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Create a school (409 SCHOOL_CODE_TAKEN / POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE). Names may repeat (M12).

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `name` | string | ✓ |  |
| `countryCode` | string |  | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; default RW. |
| `code` | string |  | Rwanda only: the official code (6 digits; first digit = province). |
| `province` | string |  |  |
| `district` | string |  |  |
| `sector` | string |  |  |
| `location` | string |  | Required outside Rwanda; in Rwanda defaults to "Sector, District". |
| `ownership` | PUBLIC \| GOVERNMENT_AIDED \| PRIVATE |  |  |
| `cell` | string |  | Rwanda only: the cell and village (free text, as in the official directory). |
| `village` | string |  |  |
| `accommodation` | DAY \| BOARDING \| MIXED |  |  |
| `confirmPossibleDuplicate` | boolean |  | Create even though schools with the same normalised name exist nearby (recorded in the audit log). |

Returns `201` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/admin/schools/import`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Import schools from a .csv or .xlsx file (at most 1 MB / 1,000 schools). All-or-nothing: any
invalid row → 422 and nothing is created. Possible duplicates need confirmPossibleDuplicates
with the reviewToken of a dry run (409 when unconfirmed or changed since the review).
dryRun=true validates only (200); a successful import returns 201.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `dryRun` | query | boolean |  | Validate and report only; create nothing. |
| `confirmPossibleDuplicates` | query | boolean |  | Import rows that have possible duplicates — requires the reviewToken of the dry run that showed them. |
| `reviewToken` | query | string |  | From the dry run (or a 409 response): binds the confirmation to this file, these candidates and this Administrator. |

Returns `201` JSON.

### POST `/api/v1/admin/users/invite`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Invite a person: the account is created without a password and an
activation link (valid 7 days) is e-mailed. Students need a gradeLevel.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `firstName` | string | ✓ |  |
| `lastName` | string | ✓ |  |
| `email` | string (email) | ✓ |  |
| `username` | string |  | Optional; generated from the e-mail address when omitted. |
| `role` | STUDENT \| MENTOR \| ADMIN \| TEACHER \| HEAD_COACH \| SUPER_ADMIN |  | Defaults to STUDENT. |
| `gradeLevel` | S1 \| S2 \| S3 \| S4 \| S5 \| S6 |  | Required for students (S1–S6); determines the division. |
| `schoolId` | string (uuid) |  | The student's school: an EXISTING school, by id and/or official code (PR B). Invitations and CSV imports never create a school — an Administrator creates it first (POST /admin/schools). |
| `schoolCode` | string |  | A Rwandan school's 6-digit official code (alternative to schoolId; both must name the same school). |
| `schoolName` | string |  | Optional check only: when given with schoolCode / schoolId it must be that school's name (case, accents and punctuation ignored), otherwise the invitation or row is refused (SCHOOL_NAME_MISMATCH). Alone it is refused (SCHOOL_REFERENCE_REQUIRED) — it never creates or matches a school. |
| `schoolLocation` | string |  | Accepted for compatibility with earlier clients and CSV files; not used (the school's own location applies). |
| `homeLocation` | string |  |  |

Returns `201` JSON with:

`invitation` object · `user` object

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |

| `country` | string |  | Country of the school (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Default RW (Rwanda). Rwanda: the school comes from the official directory (schoolCode). Any other country: the school name is recorded as entered, unverified — never matched to a Rwandan school. |
| `schoolCode` | string |  | Rwanda: official code of the school attended (6 digits, from GET /schools/search or the Province → District → Sector listing). The student is linked to exactly that school. Required unless schoolName is sent. |
| `schoolName` | string |  | Another country: the school's name as entered (unverified; no school is linked). Rwanda, legacy (until the sign-up form sends schoolCode): it never creates a school and links the student only when it matches exactly one school of the official list — otherwise no school until an Administrator sets it. Ignored when schoolCode is sent. |
| `schoolProvince` | string |  | Rwanda, "My school is not listed" (PR C): the school's place in the official directory, sent with schoolName — all three together (from GET /schools/locations). The claim keeps the name and place, PENDING until an Administrator matches and verifies it; an exact unique match with an active official school in that sector links that school (still PENDING). |
| `schoolDistrict` | string |  |  |
| `schoolSector` | string |  |  |
| `schoolLocation` | string |  | Legacy, with schoolName: city / region of the school (not stored). |
| `homeLocation` | string | ✓ | Student's home city / region. |

ADMIN: schools with student counts. Deprecated: use GET /admin/schools (same callers; unchanged guard).

Returns `200` JSON with:

`data` object[] · `meta` object

### GET `/api/v1/schools/{id}`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

ADMIN: a school and its students (paginated). Deprecated: use GET /admin/schools/:id and …/students.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`createdAt` string (date-time) · `id` string (uuid) · `location` string · `name` string · `students` object

### GET `/api/v1/schools/locations`

**Access:** Public

Public: Rwanda's provinces → districts → sectors that have official schools.

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/schools/search`

**Access:** Public

Public, for the sign-up form: official schools by name or code (max 10), or every
official school of a district / sector (Rwanda: Province → District → Sector → School).

Returns `200` JSON, an array of objects with:

`code` string · `district` string or null · `id` string (uuid) · `location` string · `name` string · `sector` string or null

## Submissions

### POST `/api/v1/assignments/{assignmentId}/distribute`

**Access:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

Spread all unassigned submissions across the mentors of this course × division.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `assignmentId` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `strategy` | BALANCED \| ROUND_ROBIN |  | Defaults to the `submissions.defaultDistributionStrategy` setting. |
| `mentorIds` | string[] |  | Restrict distribution to these mentors. Omit to use every mentor assigned to the assignment's course × division. |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`batchId` string (uuid) · `byMentor` object · `distributed` integer · `strategy` string

### PATCH `/api/v1/submissions/{id}/request-resubmission`

**Access:** MENTOR, HEAD_COACH

Ask the student for a new attempt, with a note and an optional due date
(default: the assignment deadline or 7 days from now, whichever is later).
Only where the assignment permits resubmissions.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `note` | string | ✓ | What the student should change. Shown to the student. |
| `dueAt` | string |  | When the new attempt is due (ISO-8601, within 60 days). Defaults to the assignment deadline or 7 days from now, whichever is later. |

Returns `200` JSON with:

`answerText` string · `assignment` object · `createdAt` string (date-time) · `files` object[] · `id` string (uuid) · `isLate` boolean · `resubmissionRequest` object · `review` object · `revisionCount` integer · `revisions` object[] · `status` string · `student` object · `submittedAt` string (date-time)

## Teacher

### GET `/api/v1/teacher/students`

**Access:** TEACHER

Teachers only: every registered student of the schools an Administrator has assigned to you
(active school assignments) — name, username, grade, division, school. Other roles: 403.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `schoolId` | query | string |  | One of the teacher's schools (default: all of them). |
| `gradeLevel` | query | S1 \| S2 \| S3 \| S4 \| S5 \| S6 |  |  |
| `q` | query | string |  | Name or username contains. |

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/teacher/students/{id}`

**Access:** TEACHER

A student of your assigned schools: profile and account status, no contact details. Needs the students.viewProfile delegation.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### GET `/api/v1/teacher/students/{id}/progress`

**Access:** TEACHER

A student of your assigned schools: assignment availability and submission history, no scores or feedback. Needs the students.viewProgress delegation.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Returns `200` with no body.

### POST `/api/v1/teacher/students/{id}/submissions`

**Access:** TEACHER

Submit for a student of your assigned schools (multipart, as POST /submissions). Needs the
submissions.submitOnBehalf delegation. The student stays the owner; you are recorded as the submitter.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|:-:|---|
| `id` | path | string | ✓ |  |

Body (multipart/form-data):

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|:-:|---|
| `assignmentId` | string (uuid) | ✓ | The published assignment being submitted to. |
| `answerText` | string |  | The student's typed answer for this attempt. |
| `note` | string |  | Optional note from the student about this submission/revision. |

Returns `201` with no body.
